program_evidence.rule_text: Planning review, not award approval. DTE nonresidential account must be current and in good standing; site must be in DTE Electric territory. Operator must have site rights and qualifying on-road plug-in vehicles owned or planned within 24 months of application. New equipment, five-year ownership/maintenance, 97% uptime, and a dedicated DTE meter or qualified network provider are required. Applicable load commitments/demand ceilings and the full agreement must be addressed. Level 2 ceiling is $2500 per port; Electric Choice receives 35% of that rate. DTE controls site/participant caps and final compliance/document review; amounts and availability can change. No cost-percentage limit or fixed site cap is specified here. Do not invent either, or a universal approval-before-purchase rule.
